evidence: Users receive fewer base tokens than their quote amount should purchase. Settlement uses the correct (smaller) `quoteDelta` and `baseDelta` values, but the user's order is marked as fully filled despite only partial execution.

evidence: This check passes because `newOrder.amount` has been incorrectly reduced to 0, even though dust quote amount remains unfilled. This violates the FOK guarantee that orders either execute completely or fail entirely.

evidence: The incorrect `matchedAmount` is used to decrement the incoming order's remaining amount in both [bid](https://github.com/code-423n4/2025-07-gte-clob/blob/9f06332ebd4cfe2577d9eae81aeb58d3662ffccd/contracts/clob/CLOB.sol#L763) and [ask](https://github.com/code-423n4/2025-07-gte-clob/blob/9f06332ebd4cfe2577d9eae81aeb58d3662ffccd/contracts/clob/CLOB.sol#L797) matching loops. This over-subtraction causes the matching loop to terminate prematurely, preventing the order from continuing to match against additional liquidity.
